name: wShadowOAM
evidence: OAM DMA source: the routine copied to FF80 writes rDMA=$C0 (00:05AC); cleared by 00:0A09; filled by the sprite engine 00:0956

name: wTimerBFrames
evidence: frames counter (0-59) advanced by Int_VBlank when C69F bit0 is set; followed by seconds (C267) and minutes (C268, limit [C26D])

name: wFrameServiceRan
evidence: set to 1 by 00:0392 each time it attempts the bank-04 service (the stub may still return A=$FF without entering bank 04); later calls in the same frame skip; cleared by every VBlank (00:043A/0443)

name: wTimerAFrames
evidence: frames counter (0-59) advanced by Int_VBlank when C69F bit4 is set; followed by seconds (C2D5) and minutes (C2D6, cap $46)

name: wVBlankFlag
evidence: saturating counter incremented by Int_VBlank (00:03CD); wait loops halt until non-zero then clear it (00:044B/0464/047A)

name: wOAMDMASuppress
evidence: non-zero: Int_VBlank skips `call $FF80` (00:03BB); set while the sprite engine rebuilds the shadow OAM (00:0956-09A5)

name: wTimerEnable
evidence: bit4 enables the timer at C2D4, bit0 enables the timer at C266 (00:03D0-0404)

name: wMobileFlags
evidence: bit6 set while an API call is running (00:016E..01AB), bit1 makes Int_Timer skip (00:0203); mirrors pokecrystal wc822

name: wMobileAPIIndex
evidence: A passed to 00:0150; index used by 75:4030 to select the handler (mirrors pokecrystal wMobileAPIIndex)

name: wBank4State
evidence: banked WRAM (state of whichever WRAM bank is selected; Boot/0392 select bank 1 first): bit7 = ROM bank 4 code active, bit6 = deferred stub call pending (00:2116/2129/2141)

name: wBank4SavedBankLo
evidence: ROM bank low byte saved by 00:20EE and restored by 00:210B

name: wBank4SavedBankHi
evidence: ROM bank hi byte saved by 00:20EE and restored by 00:210B

name: wBank4DeferredCall
evidence: return address of a deferred 20A6 stub call (D003 lo, D004 hi)

name: wBank4ReadBank
evidence: ROM bank (D026 lo, D027 hi) read by 00:215E/216F

name: wSpriteSlots
evidence: WRAM bank 7: 14 sprite objects x 16 bytes walked by 00:0956, initialised to $FF by 00:09B6

name: hROMBankLo
evidence: mirror of the MBC5 ROM bank low byte: written together with every [$2000/$2100] write (00:0622, 00:0324, 00:20FF); read by FarCall/interrupt handlers to save the bank

name: hROMBankHi
evidence: mirror of the MBC5 bank bit 8 written to [$3000] (00:0324, 00:2105); saved/restored with FF8A by 00:0150/01B7/01ED/20EE

name: hWRAMBank
evidence: mirror of rSVBK kept by the BankSwitch_* helpers, 00:0684, 00:0956... (each paired with ldh [rSVBK],a); NOT updated by Boot (00:02C1-02D2, 0305/030B) nor by the frame service (03AD/03B3), which restore rSVBK from a pushed value

name: hBootA
evidence: register A at the entry point (first instruction of 00:0278: ldh [$FFA3],a); $11 = CGB; cleared later by the HRAM wipe at 00:02ED-02F4

name: hFarCallTrampoline
evidence: first byte of the 8-byte RAM code FFA8-FFAF (operands named separately) built by 00:0684: ld a,imm ; ld hl,imm16 ; jp imm16 -- operands patched at FFA9, FFAB/AC, FFAE/AF by the far-call routines; executed via call/jp $FFA8

name: hFarCallA
evidence: operand of the trampoline `ld a,imm`: A passed to / returned from a far call (00:06D1, 00:06FF)

name: hFarCallHL
evidence: operand of the trampoline `ld hl,imm16`: HL passed to / returned from a far call (00:06D1, 00:0701)

name: hFarCallTarget
evidence: operand of the trampoline `jp imm16`: target address of the far call, then the return address (00:06D1, 00:070D)

name: hTextY
evidence: text cursor Y in pixels: compared with $90 (screen height) in 00:1044, advanced by control codes 02/04-07/1D/1F

name: hTextX
evidence: text cursor X in pixels (FFBD lo, FFBE hi): compared with $A0 (screen width) in 00:1044, +6 per narrow glyph (00:1079), +12 per wide

name: hScratchA
evidence: holds A across `ldh a,[hROMBankLo]`-style reads (pattern ldh [FFF2],a / ldh a,[FFF2]) and carries the bank byte of far calls

name: hFarBank
evidence: bank byte used by the inline-16 far call/jump variants (00:06BC/0716) and stored by the HDMA routine 00:0749

name: hVRAMBank
evidence: mirror of rVBK: 00:0761 (and $01 ; ldh [FFF4],a ; ldh [rVBK],a), 00:06B2

name: hSRAMEnable
evidence: mirror of the RAM-enable register [$0000]: $0A written together with [$0000] (00:15D3-15D7), 0 when disabled (00:0684)

name: hFramesWithoutService
evidence: Int_VBlank: incremented when C2BF==0 (service did not run this frame), reset to 0 otherwise (00:0435-0443)

name: hRandomIndex
evidence: index into Table_00_0C34, incremented by Random (00:0C18)

name: hRandomState
evidence: state of Random: new = (5*old+2) xor table[index] (00:0C18)
